title: Fixed ringed-site Hom augmentation, action and ordinary-to-derived comparison
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ have object universe $c$ and morphism universe $v$, let $J$ be a Grothendieck topology with sheafification of $\operatorname{AddCommGrpCat}_{\max(c,v,r)}$ and with locally bijective maps equal to the sheafification equivalences, and let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings in universe $\max(c,v,r)$. Use its module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], cochain complexes and derived localization $Q$ with independently chosen Hom universe $w$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and product-total Hom complex $H$ [def-pur-hom-complex]. Use the fixed functorial K-injective replacement $I$ and its fixed localization-factorization isomorphism $\lambda_{E,F}:R\mathcal Hom(QE,QF)\xrightarrow{\sim}QH(E,I(F))$ [def-coef-hom-representative-evaluation], with the recorded derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Define $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to I$ to be the existing natural transformation toKInjectiveResolution for this fixed replacement. For chain maps $f:E'\to E$ and $g:F\to F'$, define $H(f,g):H(E,F)\to H(E',F')$ by the existing Hom bifunctor action, first precomposing by $f$ and then postcomposing by $g$. Define $c(E,F):QH(E,F)\to R\mathcal Hom(QE,QF)$ to be the composite $Q(H(\mathrm{id}_E,\eta_F))\,;\,\lambda_{E,F}^{-1}$. These are the fixed augmentation, chain-map action and ordinary-to-derived comparison themselves, without any boundedness, projectivity, K-flatness, K-injectivity or finiteness assumption on $E,F$; no assertion of invertibility of $c(E,F)$ is part of this definition.
